headline: Euro Area Retail Sales Fall 0.7% in September
summary: Retail sales in the euro area fell 0.7% in September, exceeding expectations for a 0.1% drop, led primarily by declining purchases of non-food products.
why: Retail sales data serves as a key indicator of consumer demand and domestic economic momentum for central banks monitoring macroeconomic health.

impacts.name: Eurozone Retail Sector
impacts.why: Euro area retail sales fell 0.7% in September, driven down by weak non-food product sales.
